$description: Floating positioning (library plan wave 1, foundation floating): the gaps between an anchor and its floating element (a menu, popover, tooltip or list) and the margin a pointer-placed element keeps from the window's edges. utils/floating.js names the step; system/floating.css draws it.

floating-offset-xs.$description: Floating offset xs (the default): the gap between a menu, list or popover and its anchor.

floating-offset-sm.$description: Floating offset sm: the gap for a tooltip or a popover with a pointer.

floating-offset-md.$description: Floating offset md: the gap for a large popover beside a toolbar.

floating-viewport-margin.$description: The margin a floating element placed at the pointer (a context menu) keeps from the window's edges.
